text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan, who hasn't been feeling well 
lately, stopped to look at the amulet 
stall upon entering the shrine.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry, I was just thinking about 
my father."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My father runs a trading business, and 
wishing for my good health, he sends me 
amulets and talismans from all over the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Lucky coins, warding necklaces, even 
substitute effigy dolls, and things like 
that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...If this slump continues, I'll end up 
making my father worry again...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for bringing up such a gloomy 
topic. Let us go offer a prayer so your 
condition improves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
God, thank you as always. Please continue 
to look favorably upon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, excuse me for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, it is from my father. He is 
returning to the country soon, and invited 
me to have a meal with him."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
To show my father that I am doing well, I 
must blow away any sluggishness, mustn't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's spirits cleared up 
completely, and she truly regained her top 
condition!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"...It is from my father. He says he will 
send some cherries from Europe, where he 
is currently staying..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
...But this is quite a predicament... I'm 
actually not very fond of cherries...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Ardan's spirits plummeted, and she 
remained in poor shape afterward.
